## Overview（原文）

The SmartByte
LT-IS6518XGP-2XS16GT
is the highly reliable managed industrial PoE switch with 16-port 10/100/1000-T PoE, 4-port 1G/2.5G/10GBase-X SFP+. It complies with
IEEE802.3af PoE, IEEE802.3at PoE+ standard protocol, the Max power output consumption per port can reach 30W. In normal operation, it is a L3 managed PoE switch. It supports ERPS redundant network and the self-recovery mechanism less than 20ms on full load which allows you to scheme a reliable Ethernet network by building a redundant ring topology as your back-up solution. It also supports DHCP server, DHCP relay, IPv4/IPv6 static routing and dynamic routing protocols like
RIP, OSPFv2, BGP4, IS-IS,
robust Layer 2 management and secure functions, which can help users expand their networks quickly and efficiently.
LT-IS6518XGP-2XS16GT is also the high cost-effective easy-to-use device, which provides essential industrial Ethernet networking function, including wide range power input 44-57VDC, redundant power design with polarity reverse protection, robust IP40 fan-less housing with Din-rail installation, wide operation
temperature from -40°C to 75°C as well as high-level EMI/EMC capability. It is the best choice for heavy
industrial factory,
transportation, oil & gas, chemical,
IP Surveillance
and processing automation area
where environmental conditions are harsh and critical
.
